body.access_token: <JWT, header {"alg":"HS384"}, payload {sub, email, role, iat, exp}>

notes: Captured live 2026-09-23. access_token decodes (base64url, no signature check needed) to header {alg: HS384} and a payload carrying sub (user id), email, role, iat, exp. Assert 3 dot-separated segments, token_type == 'bearer', expires_in > 0 - not the token's exact value.
